description: Dataset for "Distributed Energy System Design including Unbalanced AC Power Flow for Large LV Networks with ADMM is a data set deposited in bl.surrey by its authors Michael Short, Oleksiy Klymenko (University of Surrey). This is the dataset used to generate results presented in "Distributed Energy System Design including Unbalanced AC Power Flow for Large LV Networks with ADMM". Data is presented for the main results section, comparison of central strict and relaxed solvers, constraint violation statistics, z and lambda calculation benchmarks and initial penalty value selection. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
